title: Finite etale covers algebraize over a complete Noetherian proper scheme
statement: Let (A,I) be a Noetherian I-adically complete henselian pair, let Y be proper over Spec A, and let Y_0=Y\times_A Spec(A/I). Every finite etale Y_0-scheme V is the closed fibre of a finite etale Y-scheme U.

source.place: Fundamental Groups, Lemma 0GS2, essential-surjectivity proof, complete Noetherian case
